# name: TE.CL cơ bản: TE=chunked, CL=4
# expect: 400
# source: PortSwigger 'basic TE.CL'; RFC 9112 §6.1
# why: Front-end đọc chunked (chunk 5c = 92 byte chứa cả request lậu), back-end đọc CL=4 rồi coi phần sau là request mới
---
POST / HTTP/1.1\r\n
Host: h\r\n
Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n
Content-Length: 4\r\n
\r\n
5c\r\n
GPOST / HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\nContent-Length: 15\r\n\r\nx=1\r\n
0\r\n
\r\n
